summary: FD_TC_213_3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim Opened � Not in CS � Non-EU Country � User Disputes � Manual Handoff
title: 3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim Opened � Not in CS � Non-EU Country � User Disputes � Manual Handoff
description:
Validates that when a claims company is initially rejected for a non-EU country but disputes the rejection, the system escalates to manual handoff by collecting required information.

Prerequisites:
Third-party caller type: Claims Company. Passenger has opened a claim. Case number not in CS. Country of origin: US (non-EU). User disputes the rejection.
